verdict: Uses real bl-* tags but with several incorrect APIs that break the tab/tooltip wiring: bl-tab must use slot="tabs" (not slot="nav"), bl-tab uses the name attribute (panel is not a real attribute) and bl-tab-panel links via its tab attribute (name is not a real attribute), while bl-tooltip has no content attribute (text belongs in the default slot) and the trigger must be slotted with slot="tooltip-trigger".
